status: Frozen locally after common detection cache and synthetic tests, before any new-sequence tracker output or GT evaluation. Not independent preregistration.

source_terms.source_column: No additional third-party source link for MOT20-01 in official table
source_terms.scope: Local non-commercial research; media, GT and raw traces not redistributed

selection: Entire previously unused 429-frame compressed training preview, crowded indoor station. Excludes all prior MOT17 scenes. One static camera, not a multi-scene held-out benchmark or moving-camera test.
order: Rotate two arms each repeat; fresh tracker, OpenCV seed 0 and one OpenCV thread. Compare canonical predictions and full trace hashes.

intervention.scope: Only selected second-stage (weak) pairs; confirmed row ID >=0 with predicted age >=2 (at least one fully missed previous frame).
intervention.competition: Another remaining confirmed row with predicted age exactly 1; same weak column similarity >= upstream gate .1 and selected minus competitor similarity <=.05, including negative margins. Alternative may be assigned elsewhere; no proof it owns this detection.
intervention.action: Remove only that selected pair after original assignment. Do not rerun/rematch. Return detection unmatched (ID -1), leave missed state predicted/retained within unchanged buffer. Re-evaluate each next frame; no fixed one-frame promise, lifetime extension or permanent ban.
intervention.unchanged: High stage, births/confirmation, active weak updates, uncontested weak recovery, all original weak input detections, upstream lifecycle/boxes/scores, fixed source-FPS steps, no ReID/GT/CMC/app/worker change.

evaluation.official: Clean TrackEval 12c8791b303e0a0b50f753af204249e622d0281a; MOT20 pedestrian preprocessing, CLEAR IoU .5, Identity, HOTA. Whole sequence.
evaluation.paired_errors: Exact official CLEAR reconciliation; FP at immutable (frame, cache detection), FN/IDSW at (frame, GT). No cross-run native-ID comparison.
evaluation.scenarios: Existing frozen GT-only long-low-visibility and overlap/order-exchange proxies, separate IoU .5 endpoint matching. Report missing endpoints plus paired same-ID gains/losses; not official scenario metrics or physical occlusion proof.
evaluation.screen: Research only: actual intervention >0; FP strictly lower; FN/IDSW no increase; IDF1/HOTA no decrease; zero paired same-ID recovery losses. All conditions must hold. No post-result tuning or default promotion from this one scene.
evaluation.timing: No timing or end-to-end throughput claim.

limitations: Independent of earlier selected scenes, but one compressed static-camera training sequence is not general reliability acceptance. No camera-motion, new-scene replication, physical occlusion audit or held-out leaderboard claim.
YOLO26n CPU 640/conf .1/NMS .7/cap64 reused application environment with 8.4.176 overlay; not fresh complete Alpha.2 installation. Detection limits/localisation can dominate FN.
Competition may delay a valid same-person recovery and change later assignments. No counterfactual benefit inferred from old flagged events.
ByteTrack direct offline research only; not BoT-SORT, isolated worker or Session default. No RTSP, Windows true inference/worker, 3D, endurance or throughput acceptance.
public_scope: Reviewed aggregate counts/distributions, configuration/source hashes and attributed numeric plots only. Media, GT, exact event windows, per-frame IDs, raw matrices/diagnostics, notes and local paths stay local.
